title: checkout_hooks.release
description: release of a STAPEL_ORDERS['CHECKOUT_HOOKS'] entry: on a failed checkout (checkout_failed), on cancel of a placed order (cancelled), and by the hook sweep for a checkout that never finished (orphaned). Retried until it answers ok. token may be null and the pair may never have been reserved: act on (attempt_key, hook name) and answer ok when there is nothing to release. Idempotent. The answer may carry keys beyond ok (token, errors, ...); orders reads ok only. ok: true is final: orders never re-sends that call — a companion that does not know the attempt key may answer ok: true (and log on its side) to stop the retries.

user_id.description: The account id; null for a guest (actor_id then names the guest account).

actor_id.description: The acting account id, guest or not; always sent since 0.2.0 (user_id is null for a guest).
